summary: Sets floor procedures for debating and amending six bills on water pollution reforms, closed-end fund investments, electricity supply chain reports, state utility reliability standards, natural gas permitting coordination, and disinterment of a veteran's remains, including time limits, amendment restrictions, and waivers of points of order.
